rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a special right or advantage, including social and legislative privileges.

example.english: This privilege isn't available to everyone.
example.traditional: 呢種特權唔係人人都有。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 dak6 kyun4 m4 hai6 jan4 jan4 dou1 jau5

rows.note: Use this for the honour or good fortune of having an opportunity to do something, as in ‘It is my privilege’.

example.english: It is my privilege to represent the company at this event.
example.traditional: 我可以代表公司出席呢個場合，真係好榮幸。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 doi6 biu2 gung1 si1 ceot1 zik6 ni1 go3 coeng4 hap6 zan1 hai6 hou2 wing4 hang6

rows.jyutping: faat3 leot6 zyun1 jip6 bou2 mat6 dak6 kyun4
rows.note: Use this specifically for the legal doctrine protecting lawyer–client communications from disclosure in court.

example.english: Legal professional privilege protects communications between lawyers and clients from disclosure in court.
example.traditional: 律師同客戶之間有關法律意見嘅通信，受法律專業保密特權保障，唔可以喺法庭上披露。
example.jyutping: leot6 si1 tung4 haak3 wu6 zi1 gaan1 jau5 gwaan1 faat3 leot6 ji3 gin3 ge3 tung1 seon3 sau6 faat3 leot6 zyun1 jip6 bou2 mat6 dak6 kyun4 bou2 zoeng3 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng6 pei1 lou6
